properties.description: Across all gender categories (Female, Male, NONE), the customer opinion points share a similar band-like cluster structure, forming an elongated curved distribution across the ternary coordinate domain from higher Negative values through moderate Uncertainty towards higher Positive values.

properties.statement: The Male and NONE gender categories exhibit comparable cross-view correspondence structures, linking customer count measurements in the radial stacked bar view to Negative, Positive, and Uncertainty coordinates in the ternary scatter view.

For the shared gender category NONE, the radial stacked bar view features a bar mark with the maximum radial height of 80.2 px encoding number of customers, while in the ternary scatter view, observed points form a curved band spanning from high Negative and low Uncertainty to moderate Uncertainty and high Positive, including individual point marks exhibiting the category maximums for Negative, Positive, and Uncertainty coordinates (the latter reaching 0.5006826134805336).

For Male across both views, a bar mark in the radial stacked bar chart exhibits the maximum visible number of customers with a radial height of 79.9 px, while in the ternary scatter plot, the Male points form an elongated band-like distribution spanning along the Negative-Uncertainty and Uncertainty-Positive legs, alongside distinct point marks reaching the respective maximum values for Uncertainty, Positive, and Negative.

For Female customers across the observed population, opinion points in the ternary scatter view form an elongated continuous curved band extending from higher Negative values through moderate Uncertainty towards Positive values, while in the radial stacked bar view, the bar segment in the upper-right Positive opinion sector has the greatest visible height encoding number of customers among Female segments, with a radial height of 93.9 px.

Across the observed marks measuring number of customers, the bar marks along the circumference are clustered into separated distinct groups, primarily in the positive and negative opinion sectors, with prominent empty angular gaps between the groups.

For the Female customer opinion points, observations form an elongated curved band across the ternary domain defined by Negative, Uncertainty, and Positive values, extending from higher Negative values through moderate Uncertainty toward Positive values within the observed population.

For observations where gender is Male, the distribution across Negative, Positive, and Uncertainty forms an elongated band-like arrangement spanning along the Negative-Uncertainty and Uncertainty-Positive legs in the ternary plot.

Among the observed points where gender is NONE, the distribution forms an elongated, curved band across the ternary coordinate frame defined by Negative, Positive, and Uncertainty, extending from high Negative and low Uncertainty toward moderate Uncertainty and toward high Positive, with some unresolved regions noted in the observed population.

Across the ternary coordinate space of Negative, Positive, and Uncertainty, the observed point marks form an elongated inverted V-shaped band extending from high Negative and low Positive values through elevated Uncertainty toward high Positive and low Negative values.
Among observed Female members, the bar reaching the maximum encoded number of customers has a radial height of 93.9 px.
Among the observed points with gender NONE, a point mark reaches the maximum Negative value.
Among the observed Male marks, the bar segment with the maximum number of customers has a radial height of 79.9 px.
Among observed members within the gender NONE category, the bar mark encoding the maximum number of customers reaches a radial height of 80.2 px.
Among the observed marks, the Female bar segment reaches the maximum number of customers, with a radial height of 93.9 px.
Among the observed members where gender is Male, a point mark has the maximum Uncertainty.
Among the observed Male points, a point mark achieves the maximum Positive value.
Among the observed Male points, an individual point reaches the maximum Negative value.
Among the observed marks with gender NONE, a point mark reaches the maximum Positive value.
Among the observed points where gender is NONE, the point with the maximum Uncertainty reaches a value of 0.5006826134805336.
Among the compared gender groups NONE and Male, the NONE category attains the highest maximum Negative coordinate, exceeding the maximum observed in the Male group.

Between the observed Male and NONE gender groups, the NONE group exhibits the higher maximum Positive value, with its maximum point reaching a higher Positive level than the maximum point observed in the Male group.

Among the observed points in the Male and NONE gender groups, the Male category exhibits the highest maximum Uncertainty, surpassing the maximum Uncertainty of 0.5006826134805336 observed for the point in the NONE group.

Female is the visually supported global number of customers maximum from the subgroup comparisons across gender breakdowns. The maximum Female bar segment has a radial height of 93.9 px, surpassing the maximum bar segments for NONE at 80.2 px and Male at 79.9 px.

Across the Female, Male, and NONE gender categories, customer opinion points exhibit a similar band-like cluster structure, each forming an elongated continuous curved distribution across the ternary domain from higher Negative values through moderate Uncertainty towards higher Positive values.
